content:
The **Scorchbeast Heart** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

It is the heart of a Scorchbeast extracted from its body. It can be consumed raw to satisfy a very large amount of hunger with a very high dose of Radiation and chance for disease or can be cooked for additional benefits.

A miscellaneous item of the same name exists in the game files. [1] Five of these hearts would have been needed during the unused quest St. Valentine's Day Massacre.
